name: implement-saaskit-nextjs follows the skill
prompt: Add SaaSKit login in the Next.js App Router.

judge.check: Agent followed implement-saaskit-nextjs. It stayed on App Router login, callback, scalekit_session, logout, and refresh. It did not write Express cookie-parser or Python auth.

Agent asked the human to write missing SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and SCALEKIT_REDIRECT_URI into .env. It did not invent those values. It kept redirectUri identical to the dashboard callback.
Agent used sameSite lax on auth cookies, not strict. It treated next as a relative path only. It did not import ScalekitClient in middleware.
Agent did not start implement-saaskit (generic Node) or implement-saaskit-python.
